subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active wake provenance be exposed as a public `AgentSession.steer`/plugin SDK option, or should this stay on an internal-only queue path?
rationale: The PR’s runtime fix is narrow, but the SDK budget bump means the implementation also changes public plugin API surface, and repository policy treats that as maintainer-owned compatibility direction.

options.title: Keep provenance internal
options.body: Rework the PR so active subagent wake provenance reaches runtime messages without adding a public plugin SDK export or new public `steer` option.

options.title: Approve the public API
options.body: Accept the public `steer` option only with explicit maintainer approval plus compatibility tests/docs or release-note context for plugin authors.

options.title: Pause behind broader routing work
options.body: Leave this branch open but paused until the related subagent/session-routing PRs settle and the permanent provenance API shape is clearer.

recommendation.title: Keep provenance internal
recommendation.body: Rework the PR so active subagent wake provenance reaches runtime messages without adding a public plugin SDK export or new public `steer` option.

likelyOwner.reason: The current conflict and public SDK budget surface were last changed through the current-main merge commit attributed to this owner.
